does: Fills a dummy from an existing entity of the level, by what the entity carries: a character (through its template and the character preparation), a light, an item, an effect (its resource becomes the dummy's visual resource) or a plain visual.

evidence.says: The branches test ecl::Character, ls::LightComponent, the item check, ls::EffectComponent and ls::VisualComponent on the source entity in that order; its two callers are the timeline system's functions that make a dummy for a registered actor.
A probe while a dialog with no cast in the level starts shows no call, while the template overload runs 7 times.
EoCClient.dll exports this name; it is tied to this function by the job its read shows
The macOS build's symbols hold this name; nothing but the name ties it to this function

questions.ask: Start a dialog whose speakers stand in the level and count its calls.
A dialog started by the host with itself as the speaker shows no call; start a dialog whose speakers stand in the level and count its calls.
